case: A glTF with an external buffer and a texture in a subdirectory, read through its ZIP: extraction under the cache, a single root directory walked through, content routed to the glTF driver.
rule: A container changes nothing about the scene it wraps. The test first compares the compilation from the archive with that of the same glTF outside the archive, cache key included; booby-trapped archives are refused by their code and never half extracted.
